newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian palm olein stable, CPO softer.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian palm olein stable, CPO softer.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were little changed and crude palm oil (CPO) prices were softer in slow early trading on Monday, traders said.
"The market is still quiet. There is no real trading activity going on because people want to wait for the rupiah to settle down," one trader in Medan said.
He said both sellers and buyers were staying on the sidelines, with prices quoted mainly for small volume trades.
The trader said a firmer Malaysian market seemed to help improve sentiment in Medan.
He said no tender for CPO was scheduled on Monday.
CPO prices were quoted at 1,165/70 rupiah/kg in Medan, compared with 1,200 rupiah on Friday. Olein was little changed at 1,415 rupiah/kg in Jakarta.
